name: cursor-icons
title: Cursor Icons
description: Search, copy, and paste Cursor product icons from Raycast.
author: nick_inzucchi

commands.name: cursor-icons
commands.title: Cursor Icons
commands.subtitle: Internal
commands.description: Search, copy, and paste Cursor product icons.

preferences.name: primaryAction
preferences.title: Primary Action
preferences.description: Choose the first action shown for each icon.

preferences.name: gridColumns
preferences.title: Grid Size
preferences.description: Choose how many icons Raycast shows per row.

preferences.name: showName
preferences.title: Show Icon Names
preferences.label: Show icon names in the grid
preferences.description: Display the Cursor icon name under each preview.

preferences.name: showRecent
preferences.title: Show Recent Icons
preferences.label: Show recently used icons
preferences.description: Display recently copied or pasted icons above all icons.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
